1.title: AGI Was Achieved in February 2026 | Bernardo Aceituno
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Open-weight models now cost-competitive and governance-compliant for 90% of enterprise workloads; remaining gaps in visual understanding, memory systems, and benchmark reliability; interview with StackAI co-founder on enterprise AI adoption shift.

2.title: Anthropic Sees Imminent RSI Acceleration | Herbie Bradley
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Herbie Bradley discusses Anthropic's S-1 filing on RSI (reasoning-to-superintelligence) acceleration timelines, critiques fast-takeoff narratives, and analyzes why enterprise AI adoption stalls on organizational bottlenecks rather than capability gaps.
